final: WITH counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), total AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS n FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT counts.powerstatus, counts.n, CAST(counts.n AS REAL) / total.n AS share FROM counts CROSS JOIN total WHERE total.n IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(shares.n), AVG(shares.share), AVG(shares.share - mean_share.value) FROM shares CROSS JOIN mean_share WHERE mean_share.value IS NOT NULL AND shares.share > mean_share.value
